directories.lib: Frontend library code, imported through the $lib alias
directories.lib/components: Shared reusable UI: thin wrappers and compositions over @acme/rnd-svelte.* components
directories.lib/features: Business logic and feature modules (one folder per feature)
directories.lib/stores: Global client state (Svelte stores or runes-based .svelte.ts modules) — one state mechanism only
directories.lib/types: Frontend-only types (shared types go in packages/shared-types)
directories.api: Eden treaty client (typed from the backend `App` type) and thin API helpers — the only place that calls the backend
directories.pages: Route-level page composition (or routes/ when a router library uses file-based routing)

entryFiles.app.d.ts: Ambient declarations (e.g. wildcard module for @acme/rnd-svelte.* which ships no .d.ts)

naming.stateModules: camelCase .svelte.ts for runes state (orders.svelte.ts) or camelCase .ts for stores

requirements: Svelte + TypeScript bundled with Vite (`<script lang="ts">`) — no other UI framework
UI components come from @acme/rnd-svelte.*, themed with @acme/blue-design-tokens; never hand-roll colours, spacing or type scales that BLUE DLS defines
One client-state mechanism (Svelte stores or runes) — do not add a second state manager
Business logic belongs in lib/features/, not in pages/ or lib/components/
API calls belong in api/ (Eden treaty client) — components never call fetch directly
Pages compose features and components only
No .svelte file may exceed 300 lines — split into smaller components or extract logic to .ts modules
legacy: Projects with Vibe Start before 2026-10-07 may keep their existing frontend (React or Vue with app/features/components/hooks/services/store/layouts/pages layout). Audit them against their existing structure as advisory; do not convert. Adding a frontend app or replacing the frontend is a major improvement and needs tech-architect approval in PROJECT.md `## Stack Exceptions`.
